summary.what_it_does: The page is an article offering roughly 100 Stable Diffusion text-to-image prompts organized into categories: photography, portrait, concept art, architecture, fashion, 3D, video games, graphic design, wallpaper and cinematic. Each category has short writing tips, such as using lighting terms like "golden hour landscape" or style terms like "cyberpunk". It also includes a short FAQ on writing good prompts. The author states the prompts can also be used on Midjourney or DALL-E. The prompt texts themselves are not visible in the extracted page text; only "Prompt #1" through "Prompt #10" labels appear, so the example outputs are not shown here.
notable: Organized into about ten categories with tips for each
Prompts are said to work across Stable Diffusion, Midjourney and DALL-E
Includes a short FAQ on writing effective prompts
caveats: The actual prompt text and output images are not visible in the extracted page text
Much of the page is promotional links and unrelated pro tips, so the prompt content is thin in the text
Stable Diffusion itself is not described on this page beyond its use
